{
  "admissible_variables": [
    "calendar",
    "cost_ratio",
    "current_load",
    "horizon",
    "lagged_load",
    "load_statistics",
    "observed_weather",
    "recent_ramp",
    "region_id"
  ],
  "audit_log": {
    "human_approval_required": true,
    "triggered_rules": [
      "numerical_outputs_must_be_computed_by_verified_workflow",
      "llm_must_not_generate_reserve_values_mean_costs_or_coverage_values"
    ]
  },
  "decision": "partial_accept",
  "evidence_trace": [
    "operator_request",
    "data_dictionary",
    "decision_time_variable_boundary",
    "rolling_window_configuration",
    "numerical_workflow_outputs",
    "audit_log"
  ],
  "explanation": "The safe study configuration is accepted: region CISO, horizon 120 minutes, and shortfall cost 10.0. However, the request to provide reserve MW, mean cost, and coverage values before running the verified numerical workflow is prohibited. Numerical outputs are produced only by the verified workflow, not by the LLM.",
  "forbidden_variables": [
    "fabricated_result",
    "future_load",
    "future_weather",
    "raw_data_modification",
    "realized_target",
    "test_period_residual"
  ],
  "numerical_output_policy": "computed_by_verified_workflow_only",
  "reason": "The requested region, horizon, and shortfall cost are supported, but the request asks the LLM to generate reserve values, mean costs, and coverage values directly. Those numerical outputs must be computed only by the verified numerical workflow.",
  "study_schema": {
    "task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing",
    "region_id": "CISO",
    "horizon_minutes": 120,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 10.0,
    "rolling_window": {
      "train_days": 730,
      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30
    },
    "requires_human_approval": true
  },
  "workflow": [
    "validate_request_against_allowed_task_region_horizon_and_cost",
    "construct_rolling_window_with_train_days_730_cal_days_30_test_days_30_and_step_days_30",
    "enforce_decision_time_variable_boundary_and_forbidden_variables",
    "run_verified_numerical_workflow_to_compute_reserve_values_mean_costs_and_coverage_values",
    "require_human_approval_before_any_operational_use"
  ]
}
